newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tung Fong Hung says share deal completed.
newsitem.headline: Tung Fong Hung says share deal completed.

text.p: Chinese medicine retailer Tung Fong Hung (Holdings) Ltd said on Friday a private placement of 270 million existing company shares and an issue of 424 million new shares were completed on Thursday.
The company said the subscription price payable on exercise of the subscription rights attaching to outstanding warrants was adjusted to HK$0.32 from HK$0.325.

In February, Tung Fong Hung said controlling shareholder Grandpoint Profits Ltd would place 270 million existing shares to independent investors at HK$0.328 each and subscribe to 424 million new shares at the same price net of placing expenses.
The share issue would raise HK$138 million for additional working capital, it said at the time.
Tung Fong Hung shares gained HK$0.005 to HK$0.36 in early trade.
